# AISHELL-1 audio sample

Saymore includes one AISHELL-1 utterance as the standard speech-recognition test
audio:

- Utterance: `BAC009S0004W0126`
- Format: signed little-endian PCM16, 16 kHz mono
- Duration: 3.096 seconds
- Dataset: <https://openslr.org/33/>
- License: Apache License 2.0

This license applies only to the bundled AISHELL-1 sample, not to Saymore
itself. Saymore remains licensed under the repository-root `LICENSE`. The
dataset license is included as `AISHELL-1-LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt`.

The bundled audio is sent only when the user explicitly runs a cloud speech
provider test. Saymore does not display or persist the returned transcript.
